RP STATED THAT THERE WERE FIVE (5) EMPLOYEES TAKEN TO A HOSPITAL IN A PASSENGER VEHICLE FOR MEDICAL EXAMINATION. RP STATED THAT THE FIVE (5) EMPLOYEES WERE RELEASED AFTER OBSERVATION WITH NO REPORTED INJURIES. THE IMPACT IS ATMOSPHERE. **RP STATED IT IS UNKNOWN IF THE RQ WAS EXCEEDED.

properties.title: NRC Report: Diesel Fuel 1 near Sitka, AK
properties.summary: Incident Type: FIXED - NRC Report ID: 895344 - Medium Affected: SUBSURFACE - Suspected Responsible Party: US COAST GUARD
properties.content:
NRC Report ID: 895344
Incident Time: 2009-01-09 18:00:00
Nearest City: Sitka, AK
Incident Type: FIXED
Material: DIESEL FUEL 1
Medium Affected: SUBSURFACE
Suspected Responsible Party: US COAST GUARD
Skytruth Analysis
Reported Spill Volume: 16 gallons
AVIATION AIRPORT RAMP OIL WATER SEPARATOR AND IT'S OUTFALL WERE COVERED BY SNOW PILED AND BLOWN TO THAT AREA DURING SNOW REMOVAL OPERATIONS. OIL WATER IS ROUTINELY INSPECTED AND SOUNDED AND WATER CUT WEEKLY BY CG ENVIRONMENTAL STAFF. ON 1/9/09 OWS HAD TO BE DUG OUT. IT WAS WARMING AND RAINING. OWS OUTFALL WAS DISCOVERED TO BE FROZEN, WITH SOME OIL DISCHARGED THROUGH THE TOP OF THE OWS MANHOLE. THE DRAIN WAS THAWED AND THE OWS WAS RETURNED TO NORMAL. A SOUNDING AND WATER CUT TAKEN AFTER THE OWS WAS ABLE TO STABILIZE SHOWED A LOSS OF APPROXIMATELY 15.5 GALLONS TO DOWNSTREAM A POND/LAGOON. SORBENTS WERE PLACED IN THE CONCRETE SUMP, DRAINAGE DITCH, AND LAGOON AS SOON AS THE OUTFALL WAS DISCOVERED TO BE FROZEN AND APPROXIMATELY 14 GALLONS OF OIL HAS BEEN RECOVERED. SORBENTS ARE BEING LEFT IN THE AREA TO RECOVER RESIDUAL OIL IF POSSIBLE.
